def _install_eslint(self, bootstrap_dir):
    """Install the ESLint distribution.

    :rtype: string
    """
    eslint_dir = os.path.join(bootstrap_dir, 'eslint')
    if not os.path.exists(eslint_dir):
        os.makedirs(eslint_dir)

    # Download the ESLint distribution.
    eslint_url = 'https://github.com/eslint/eslint/releases/download/v%s/eslint-%s.zip' % (
        self.eslint_version, self.eslint_version)
    eslint_zip = os.path.join(eslint_dir, 'eslint.zip')
    self._download(eslint_url, eslint_zip)

    # Unzip the ESLint distribution.
    self._unzip(eslint_zip, eslint_dir)

    # Install the ESLint distribution.
    eslint_bin = os.path.join(eslint_dir, 'eslint-%s' % self.eslint_version, 'bin', 'eslint')
    if not os.path.exists(eslint_bin):
        raise Exception('ESLint binary not found: %s' % eslint_bin)

    return eslint_bin
